company.name: MilkRun
company.shortDescription: MilkRun is an online marketplace and grocery delivery service that connects consumers and Chefs directly with hundreds of local farmers.
company.description: MilkRun provides an online retail channel for small and mid-sized producers to engage directly with their customers, orchestrating the direct sale, distribution and fulfillment of locally grown and made goods. With an end-to-end solution, MilkRun can deliver a 6x improvement to producers by using technology to deploy the pre-industrial distribution model for local food systems.
